researchEvidence.note: Official DOL Asbestos Control Bureau page reviewed; it links an Asbestos Contractors Listing and describes DOL oversight of asbestos abatement hazards.
Official DOL page reviewed; Industrial Code Rule 56 requires licensing of contractors, certification of persons working on asbestos projects, project notifications, surveys, and abatement methods.
Official DOL licensing page reviewed; it states asbestos contractors must meet strict requirements to be licensed.

Official DOL asbestos facts publication reviewed; it states that DOL maintains a list of licensed contractors and that asbestos abatement work must use trained workers and certified contractors where required.

blocker.summary: DOL provides an official asbestos contractor listing, but no adapter-reviewed machine-readable source contract, privacy filter, update cadence, checksum behavior, or redistribution path has been established.
